authority.allowed: Synthetic-only reconciliation and the smallest unambiguous committed-semantics validator repair.
forbidden_and_not_performed: monitoring, deployment, activation, operator identity, or EB2 changes

semantic_evidence.finding: TopologyNode carries entity_ref and local_role as separate required fields and imposes no entity-wide role uniqueness constraint.
TopologyRevision canonicalizes nodes by the compound key (entity_ref, local_role), making distinct roles on one entity deterministic.
The watchtower producer keys nodes by (entity_ref, local_role).
The independent three_sw2 producer also keys nodes by (entity_ref, local_role).

semantic_decision.edge_validation_rule: An edge is valid only when at least one role on its source node-set and one role on its destination node-set form a declared (source_role, destination_role, primitive_type) rule.

repair.before: Validation reduced nodes to one local_role per entity_ref, losing committed node identity.
repair.after: Validation retains the complete local-role set per entity and checks every edge for at least one declared role pairing.

cases: one entity validly occupies destination and source roles across two edges

smallest_separately_authorized_next_prog.name: fresh bounded retained-evidence derivation
smallest_separately_authorized_next_prog.scope: One fresh atomic invocation of the committed PSI0G-B runner against the two PSI0G-A-bound stores after rebinding their unchanged identities and the PSI0G-B1 repair revision.

terminal_states.PASS: Both complete EP3 runtime payload sets and EP4 candidate payload sets publish atomically and replay deterministically.
terminal_states.HOLD: Any new contract, evidence, resource, identity, or replay failure stops without retry or partial publication.

smallest_separately_authorized_next_prog.still_forbidden: Provider/RPC acquisition, disposition, F13 export, PSI0F publication, monitoring, deployment, or activation.

terminal_statement: PASS. EP3 roles are unambiguously node-scoped; the validator now preserves that committed identity while continuing to reject undeclared roles, endpoints, primitive types, and role pairings. No real derivation was rerun.
